info.bio: Subhumans es una banda punk inglesa formada en 1979. La banda lanzó una demo en 1980 llamada "demolition war". Esta demo fue escuchada por miembros de Flux of Pink Indians. Estos quedaron tan impresionados con el trabajo de Subhumans que le ofrecieron sacar un album en la discográfica Spiderleg creada por Flux of Pink Indians. Más tarde comenzaron a sacar albums con su propia doscográfica "Bluurg". A fines de 1985 la banda se separó. en 1998 Subhumans volvieron a los escenarios hasta dia de hoy.

scenes.desc: La gira de los Ramones de 1976 contagia a Inglaterra, donde el punk es combinación de moda y paro: la Gran Bretaña de Thatcher, con las ciudades industriales devastadas, convierte el «punk» en algo mucho más serio que lo que pretendían los Ramones. Malcolm McLaren inventa el sonido (Sex Pistols, «los Ramones con heroína y valium») y la imagen. The Clash, los más intelectuales (London Calling, Sandinista); Damned, Generation X, Buzzcocks (inventores del punk-pop), Vibrators. En Australia, Radio Birdman y los Saints. La segunda ola (GBH, UK Subs, Neurotics, New Model Army, Stiff Little Fingers) y el punk anarquista (Crass, Discharge, Rudimentari Peni, Subhumans).

podcast.title: Geographical Origin
podcast.body: The Subhumans were a hardcore punk band from the West Coast of Canada, a region described as having fertile ground for the genre. "But the West Coast had the most fertile ground, the subhumans and day glue abortions, for example."

podcast.title: Jerry Hanna's Arrest and Litton Industries Bombing – Punk Activism Leading to Jail Time
podcast.body: The Subhumans formed in Vancouver in 1978 with original members known as Useless, Dimwit, Wimpy, and Normal. Original singer Useless (real name Jerry Hanna) quit in 1981 and joined a group called Direct Action, also known as the Vancouver Five or Squamish Five. On October 14, 1982, Direct Action bombed a plant owned by Litton Industries in Toronto — which manufactured guidance systems for cruise missiles — injuring several workers and three police officers (no one was killed). Hanna was not part of the bombing itself but supported it and was involved in planning other actions, including a planned Brink's truck robbery using stolen automatic weapons. He was convicted and sentenced to ten years in prison, serving five. His arrest and trial rallied the punk community; multiple benefit concerts were organized. "He was convicted and sent to jail for ten years, serving five."

xref.title: First Canadian Band to Sign to Stiff Records – Power Pop Side of Vancouver Punk
xref.body: The Pointed Sticks formed in Vancouver in 1978, five former members overlapping with D.O.A. and the Subhumans. Their sound was more melodic and power pop-leaning than their contemporaries — five members singing harmonies was unusual in punk. Their name came from a Monty Python sketch about self-defense against pointed sticks. They became the first Canadian band to sign to Stiff Records in the UK, home to the Damned, Nick Lowe, Elvis Costello, and Ian Dury. Several strong singles and one album followed. Their relative accessibility broadened the audience for Vancouver punk. "Stiff Records, one of the groundbreaking indie labels in the UK."
